considered_mechanism.question: Can a lagged extreme Bitcoin mempool backlog identify a congestion or speculative-excess state in which a matched-capital BTC long-or-cash risk veto improves drawdown without destroying total PnL?

primary_source_contract.documented_transport: GET https://api.blockchain.info/charts/$chartName with UTC date parameters and JSON or CSV format
primary_source_contract.documented_semantics: Mempool count is the number of unconfirmed transactions; mempool size is the aggregate bytes waiting for confirmation and is assembled from Blockchain.com Bitcoin nodes.

deduplication_boundary.distinction_if_source_had_passed: An unconfirmed backlog level is a stock of unmet blockspace demand, whereas the closed family used confirmed native transaction-fee growth as a DRA admission flow.
deduplication_boundary.outcome_aware_rescue_prohibited: Do not substitute confirmed fees, transaction count, active addresses, exchange flow, MVRV or NVT after the mempool route failed; those primitives already have sealed terminal dispositions.

material_learning: A visible public chart is not an executable historical data path. The documented no-credential chart API returned 404 for both mempool count and mempool size, so the mechanism stops at DATA_REJECT instead of using a manual export or substituting a related closed on-chain primitive.
